cohort: Four published Marionette 5.1.0 applications and four functioning applications per peer

generationTimingDefinition.start: Adapter monotonic timer immediately before turn/start RPC
generationTimingDefinition.end: Root turn/completed notification observed by adapter
generationTimingDefinition.includes: Model turn, tool work, documentation reads and self-tests within that turn
generationTimingDefinition.excludes: CLI startup, subscription/config/tooling preflight, post-turn service checks, output drain/shutdown, independent acceptance and Lighthouse
generationTimingDefinition.notDerivedFrom: finished_at minus started_at; finished_at is recorded after post-turn shutdown
generationTimingDefinition.consistency: Same timing boundary and field for every application in all six frameworks
